scripts.build: npm run sources && npm run build:wasm && vite build && node scripts/finish-build.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src scripts tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src scripts tests vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --locked --manifest-path vendor/brush/Cargo.toml -p brush-interactive --features vt --lib vt:: && cargo test --locked --manifest-path vendor/brush/Cargo.toml -p brush-builtins --lib printf:: && cargo test --locked --manifest-path rust/brush-browser/Cargo.toml
